integrity: All identities are derived from the published stage update; finite tests supplement rather than replace the global convexity proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact known frequencies; fixed-step decoupled canonical planar oscillators; exact mode-wise Gaussian shape from continuous extension; no general Hamiltonian symplecticity or nonlinear energy conservation. Quantitative analytic refinement of a previously published stability function; bibliographic priority remains unconfirmed.
title: A unique accidental symplectic step and a sharp long-time damping law for Gaussian RBF-RK2 oscillators
